cases.brief: Provide self-service cancellation for confirmed bookings, restricted to their owners and before their start time; preserve idempotence. Refunds are excluded. Validate unauthorized users and the time boundary.

POLICY1.title: Synthetic confirmed booking policy
POLICY1.text:
Reception staff currently contact support to cancel bookings.
Self-service cancellation reduces the need to contact support.
This change covers cancellation of confirmed bookings.
Payment refunds are outside the scope of this change.
Only the booking owner may cancel a confirmed booking, and only before its start time. At or after its start time the booking remains confirmed. Requests from anyone other than the owner leave the booking confirmed. Repeating cancellation of an already cancelled booking leaves it cancelled.
